findings.title: A week's forecast and insights change inside the week from records made from its first day on (second source, athlete correction)
findings.observed: Device reports recorded Wednesday of week index 5 for the 12 runs of weeks 1-4 replace the in-force app rows by conflicted rows first recorded that Wednesday; each session reads MISSING_REPORT; Monday one range [2820,2940,3075] mean 1 -> Thursday BOTH_RANGES observed [2910,3000,3075] plan [2835,2955,3075] mean 0. Athlete corrections recorded that Wednesday (chain keeps its first-recorded instant): same change, mean 0.11. Insights: corrections of past threshold work pace move THRESHOLD from STABLE/NONE (Monday) to IMPROVING/EXPLAIN_ONLY (Thursday). The author's T5 (test/v1rfc-properties.test.mjs:78) sends only new first reports.
contract: handoff section 4 (update only at the week boundary)
findings.alsoFrozen: The V1RC calibration of the current week itself moves inside the week with such corrections (threshold [325,360] f0 -> [315,350] +0.03): frozen file, escalate to the Founder; not a precondition of the phase-B closure.
findings.closes: The week's forecast and insights read only what was in force at the cutoff, or, when a session's reports changed since the cutoff (the race-week test of report facts before and since), the week shows a withdrawal with a reason until the next boundary, never a changed number; result tests inside the week for correction, second source and conflict, for the forecast and the insights; T5 extended to those shapes.

findings.title: Check (a) of handoff 9.1, extended by preflight R3, fails after a correction; stop point S6 not applied; the author's record says confirmed
findings.observed: runCalibrationOf re-read for past weeks after a correction recorded in week index 9: week index 7 [310,330] f0 -> [305,325] +0.015; week index 8 [325,360] f0 -> [320,355] +0.015. The author's check test (v1rfc-entry.test.mjs:231) has no correction.
findings.impact: insights' band of each execution's own week (K.viewOf), pair A eligibility, revision replay, race-week recompute (guarded only by report facts)
findings.closes: Read the recorded value (the band as delivered, which the run formats' record already stores per emitted format, or a per-week record), or a written Founder+SSCTR decision accepting the re-derivation (the cause is frozen V1RC); correct the record; a test of check (a) with a correction.

findings.title: After a restart, rows of the previous plan credit sessions of the new plan (plan-relative session ids collide)
findings.observed: New 8-week plan after a restart, nothing reported in it: week 0 sessions w0-run-d1/d3/d6 credited 1 COMPLETED from rc-done-w0-run-d1... of January's plan; two weeks in, weeks 0 and 1 COMPLETED x3 each, adherence mean 1 (gain credited for training not done). The frozen run formats also bind the old execution to the new session; phase B's eventId check passes. Insights read old threshold rows as new-plan sessions against a new-plan week's band.
findings.closes: Phase B reads, for credit and for pace, only a row dated inside its own session's week of the plan in force (never before its start); result test of a restart with colliding ids, forecast and insights. The collision inside the frozen run formats is recorded as their condition, for the Founder.

findings.title: Pace revision replay is not stable: a later correction silently erases an accepted step and a new offer appears 7 days later
findings.observed: DEVR: week-9 offer 0.02 accepted; weeks 10-11 sized at [305,340]; a correction in week 11 of one voting session (268 -> 330): status OFFERED, no ENDED, ACCEPT ignored NO_SUCH_OFFER_THIS_WEEK, band [310,345], a new offer 7 days after the previous step's effective date.
findings.whyNotBlocking: V1X-PACE-REVISION is off by default, outside the freeze (the verifier refuses with it on), and needs IC-2 and its own record.
findings.closes: Before any enabling record of V1X-PACE-REVISION: an accepted step bound to what was accepted (the answer carries the offer, or the state is keyed by the answer), with result tests of a correction and a second source after acceptance.

findings.title: The withdrawal 'declared break of 14 days or more' is not applied at once; insights stay active during the break
findings.observed: A 14-day break declared Tuesday of week index 3 from that day: forecast SHOWN on Tuesday and Thursday; UNAVAILABLE only from the next week (V1RC estimate), RETURN mode later; insights ACTIVE in week indices 3 and 4. Phase B has no break check of its own.
findings.closes: The withdrawal read from the record's breaks (breaksOf exists) for the forecast and, if the SSCTR confirms L-9, the insights; a test of a break declared in advance and in progress.
